policy: 2026-11-09 user decision: AI editions report unofficial rumors first, new-model rumors with priority. A rumor is never presented as fact: every scene attributes its source and states the official status. Accounts are read-only through Agent Reach; never log in for the user or rotate accounts.

tiers.A: Repeated, checkable finds from primary artifacts (app/web code strings, API listings, feature tests). A single A-tier post may qualify on its own.
tiers.B: Frequent model leaks with a mixed record. Needs a second independent source or an artifact.
tiers.C: Aggregators or unknown authors (all search results default to C). Needs a second independent source or an artifact.

watch_accounts.name: Tibor Blaho
watch_accounts.track_record: Editorial default: posts app/web teardown strings and screenshots (artifact evidence). Re-tier with evidence if wrong.

watch_accounts.name: TestingCatalog News
watch_accounts.track_record: Editorial default: tests unreleased features and model endpoints, usually with screenshots.

search.note: One query per model family: (term OR term) (signal OR signal). Families rotate across runs so every family is searched within two runs.
